summary: NXG Cushing Midstream Energy Fund filed an 8-K reporting entry into a distribution agreement with Foreside Fund Services, LLC to conduct an at-the-market offering of up to 1,500,000 common shares. The offering is made under an existing shelf registration statement; sales price will not be less than net asset value per share plus commission. This is a routine shelf takedown to raise capital, not a special situation. The filing includes a sub-placement agent agreement with UBS Securities LLC. No watch items or risk-arb angle applicable as this is a standard equity distribution.
